scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @orca/api" "npm run dev -w @orca/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @orca/shared && npm run typecheck -w @orca/api && npm run typecheck -w @orca/web
scripts.verify: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && node scripts/check-syntax.mjs apps/web/dist && node scripts/scan-js.mjs apps/web/dist && node scripts/scan-css.mjs apps/web/dist && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs apps/web/dist
